title: Pipeline Health
description: Modern Data Platform -- Sprint 13 close-out, part 2. Every panel's query built against real Prometheus metric/label names confirmed live via the Prometheus HTTP API before this file was written (see docs/architecture/roadmap-next-steps.md), not guessed from the instrumentation code alone. Covers the 3 real metric sources documented in README's Phase 6: the processing framework (extract_postgres, via Pushgateway), the Bronze Consumer (scraped directly), and Airflow (via statsd-exporter).

panels.title: Pipeline duration (mean)
panels.description: mdp_pipeline_duration_seconds_sum / _count, by job and status. Pushed once per real extract_postgres run (PrometheusHook.push()), not scraped continuously -- see logging_config.py's sibling, prometheus_metrics_hook.py.

panels.title: Time since last pipeline run
panels.description: time() - mdp_pipeline_last_run_timestamp_seconds, per job. A staleness indicator: this should stay under the DAG's own schedule interval (30 min for marketplace_batch_pipeline's extract_postgres task) -- a value climbing well past that means the pipeline stopped running, not just slowed down.

panels.title: Stage executions by status
panels.description: sum by (stage_name, status) (mdp_stage_executions_total) -- one series per Postgres entity Stage (Extract Customers, Extract Orders, ...).

panels.title: Consumer lag by entity
panels.description: mdp_bronze_consumer_lag, per topic/entity -- see roadmap-next-steps.md for a known limitation: this can read far higher than reality for a few minutes right after a bronze-consumer restart (OFFSET_INVALID before the Consumer's local position syncs). Cross-check against `kafka-consumer-groups --describe` before reacting to a spike right after a restart.

panels.title: Messages consumed (rate, 5m)
panels.description: rate(mdp_bronze_messages_consumed_total[5m]), per entity -- real throughput, not the round-duration proxy the roadmap's own throughput investigation had to reason about before this metric existed.

panels.title: Write duration p95
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95, ...) over mdp_bronze_write_duration_seconds_bucket, per entity -- each write_deltalake() call to bronze/{entity}/.

panels.title: Write failures (1h)
panels.description: sum(increase(mdp_bronze_write_failures_total[1h])) -- should be 0. Non-zero doesn't necessarily mean data loss (the round-robin loop retries a failed flush next cycle, see roadmap-next-steps.md's livelock-fix entry), but is always worth looking at.

panels.title: Task finishes by task and state
panels.description: airflow_task_finish_total{dag_id, task_id, state} -- statsd-exporter's mapping.yml converts Airflow's dotted airflow.ti.finish.<dag>.<task>.<state> StatsD metric into these labels, one series per (task_id, state) pair.

panels.title: DAG run duration (p50/p90/p99)
panels.description: airflow_dagrun_duration_success_seconds{dag_id, quantile} -- StatsD timer, pre-aggregated into quantiles by statsd-exporter itself (not a Prometheus histogram_quantile() over raw buckets).

panels.title: Pool slots (running / queued / open)
panels.description: airflow_pool_running_slots / airflow_pool_queued_slots / airflow_pool_open_slots, per pool (catalog, ingestion, quality, transformation, default_pool).

panels.title: Scheduler heartbeat rate
panels.description: rate(airflow_scheduler_heartbeat_total[5m]) -- a liveness signal: this dropping to (near) zero for an extended window means the scheduler stopped, not just that nothing is scheduled right now.
